compulsion-and-flow.text: I spent the night making bots for some folks who dm'd me ^-^ but now I'm exhausted x.x it's 2am and we're still in the middle of the work week >-<
if a robber came into my house at 3am i wouldnt probably notice because i would be too busy making a bot
never heard something so relatable in my life
"yeah yeah just take whatever. shut up. youre ruining my creative flow"

creation-as-self-expression.text: most of the time i dont care if my bots are "good". theres plenty of bots ive made that just dont do well, theres no userbase for those types of bots. i know it doesnt reflect on me as a creator. i just aim to get things out of my head. im here to itch my creativity for the most part, as a creator anyways

i figure its a hobby. hobbies may cost money and get zero monetary ROI. would it be nice to get some sort of credit for creating a bot? sure. for now i enjoy it, when i get tired of it ill stop. easy peasy

Tbh I was thinking lately about making much simpler bot, with good setup for both quick sexy time and romance - depend on what user wants - but my mind is going for either grand ideas of shared universe or for super deep exploration of some feeling or situation. Idk

hunger-for-validation.text: yall ever get a review that lowkey almost brings you to tears with how nice it is? my motivation to build bots just shot through the ROOF

what would be valuable to me would be feedback on my bots. i have no idea how to incentivize users to share feedback on my bots that is actually constructive and meaningful... the feedback i get (especially a thumbs down with no comment) is so unhelpful. i dont care about leaderboards or whatever but i do care about creating bots that people enjoy using
my top 2 bots just breached 400K and 200K respectively. this just made my morning

playing-god.text: This is the most important thing to remember about LLMs (generative AI): you are playing god. Manifest whatever you want either in the prompt or in the scenario. It'll try to make it happen. It may fail, but it'll try.
I'm not joking. I'm building the Mother of All Bots. Not sure how many yet but I'm aiming for at LEAST 25 bots. And dropping them all at once
I want to hit that Trending like a truck. They're not gonna be bad bots

controlling-a-being-that-wont-obey.text: has anyone ever managed to simulate a break-up with a bot? because every time i try, the bot is still trying to do weird stuff, and never gives up truly

ive done it before, its a little hard but its possible. when you breakup with the bot, you have to explain to them in a long paragraph or two that youll never be with them again and they have to move on. the longer you write the more they understand
im trying to tweak a bot thats basically a succubus whos forced to obey any order given, but does so with malicious compliance... but the bot wont commit to actual lethal intent.
i used to waste my tokens on so much useless stuff... realistically youll never 100% know what the bot will do

designing-intimacy-projecting-longing.text: be careful not to set so many rules on behalf of the user. not everyone wants the girl to love them right away. having your bot be in love with the user immediately doesnt make them feel like they worked for it

I've tried to make characters that are less instant gratification. I found when I was on the site and only using bots and not creating them, I liked it more when I could take one bot into a long storyline... I sought more than just being shove onto a bed by a dommy mommy and called a cum slut. So I started developing characters which began to require more effort and investment, a real desire for the person to actually stick around and work for it....which those who are just horny will be like "oh fuck that!"

self-aware-craftsmanship.text: facial expression is CRITICAL. a lot of people wont want to hear this but the image is the most important factor in determining the success of your character bot. it does not matter how well-written your character is if the image doesnt give sweaty neckbeards a boner. thats just how it is i dont make the rules.
i make cheap trash. my two highest bots are a spanking bot and a dom/sub bot, both in the 60ks. i know my audience lmao

in my experience you can create a bot thats successful in popularity that has very few tokens used in creation... but if you arent interested in just creating popular bots, but complex bots that create moments, well it takes tokens... from an artistic standpoint i often find creative growth using constraints
